name: astro-decap-github-connect
description: Local Decap stopgap — Zod schema owner + Astro integration

scripts.dev: bun run --filter zod-decap-local build && bun run --filter fixture dev
scripts.build: bun run --filter zod-decap-local build && bun run --filter fixture build
scripts.check: bun run --filter zod-decap-local build && bun run --filter zod-decap-local check && bun run --filter fixture codegen:check
